<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex040012026-09-0404-28-09" status="unreviewed">kha yang pa mtshan nyid du 'god na phan tshun ma khyab ste gzugs kyi gnas
            skabs la btags la zhes pa'i mtshan nyid des | seMs dang seMs las byung ba'i gnas skabs
            la btags pa'i ldan pa ma yin pa'i 'du byed pa ma khyab pa las pa'i nyes pa yod pas ||
            des na ldan pa ma yin pa'i 'du byed kyi <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> ni gnas skabs la btags pa'i ldan pa ma
            yin pa'i 'dus <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="73a5"/> te la gzugs kyi gnas skabs la btags pa zhes pa g 'dus byas
            kyi gnas skabs kyi yos shes bya ba yin zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3864">skyabs</rs> gsung ngo | </seg></TEI>
